draft.subject: One small next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

You got your first project set up in Wrenfield last week — nice start. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks to that project is usually the step that makes everything else click. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through getting your team's actual work into that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
